title.zh: 课题组成立！刘华清、杨佳慧加入广西大学
title.en: Lab established! Huaqing Liu and Jiahui Yang join Guangxi University

content.zh: 2025年7月，刘华清博士正式加入广西大学林学院，杨佳慧博士正式加入广西大学农学院，共同成立土壤生态与水土保持课题组。课题组聚焦植物多样性与土壤水碳耦合、土壤有机碳形成与转化、土壤侵蚀与水土保持、多源遥感定量监测等前沿方向，欢迎有志青年加入！
content.en: In July 2025, Dr. Huaqing Liu joined the College of Forestry and Dr. Jiahui Yang joined the College of Agriculture at Guangxi University, co-founding the Soil Ecology and Conservation Lab. The lab focuses on plant diversity–soil water-carbon coupling, soil organic carbon dynamics, soil erosion and conservation, and multi-source remote sensing monitoring. We welcome aspiring students to join!

title.zh: 欢迎研究生罗曼玉加入课题组！
title.en: Welcome graduate student Manyu Luo to our lab!

content.zh: 热烈欢迎罗曼玉同学加入土壤生态与水土保持课题组！罗曼玉本科毕业于福州大学，将在杨佳慧老师指导下攻读资源利用与植物保护专业硕士学位。期待她在课题组的学习和科研中不断成长，取得丰硕成果！🎉
content.en: We are delighted to welcome Manyu Luo to the Soil Ecology and Conservation Lab! Manyu graduated from Fuzhou University and will pursue her professional master's degree in Resource Utilization and Plant Protection under the supervision of Dr. Jiahui Yang. We look forward to her growth and achievements in the lab! 🎉

title.zh: 刘华清、杨佳慧老师参加中国土壤学会土壤侵蚀与水土保持专业委员会2025年学术年会
title.en: Dr. Huaqing Liu and Dr. Jiahui Yang attend the 2025 Annual Meeting of Soil Erosion and Water Conservation Committee, Soil Science Society of China

content.zh: 2025年8月16-20日，刘华清老师和杨佳慧老师赴西藏林芝参加中国土壤学会土壤侵蚀与水土保持专业委员会2025年学术年会，分别就植物多样性与土壤水碳耦合、多源遥感定量监测与水土保持等研究方向进行了学术交流。
content.en: From August 16-20, 2025, Dr. Huaqing Liu and Dr. Jiahui Yang attended the 2025 Annual Meeting of the Soil Erosion and Water Conservation Committee, Soil Science Society of China, in Linzhi, Tibet. They presented on plant diversity–soil water-carbon coupling and multi-source remote sensing monitoring for soil-water conservation, respectively.

content.zh: 土壤生态与水土保持课题组网站（soilecology.online）正式上线！网站全面展示课题组的研究方向、团队成员、学术成果和最新动态，支持中英双语切换，欢迎访问了解更多信息。
content.en: The Soil Ecology and Conservation Lab website (soilecology.online) is now live! The site showcases our research directions, team members, publications, and latest news with bilingual support. Welcome to explore!

title.zh: 刘华清、杨佳慧老师分别获批广西自然科学基金青年项目
title.en: Dr. Huaqing Liu and Dr. Jiahui Yang each awarded Guangxi Natural Science Foundation Youth Projects

content.zh: 祝贺刘华清老师和杨佳慧老师分别获批广西自然科学基金青年科学基金项目！刘华清老师主持的项目为「树种多样性调控多源DOM输入驱动土壤碳形成与稳定」，杨佳慧老师主持的项目为「广西坡耕地土壤侵蚀定量评价与未来趋势预测」，项目执行期均为2026年4月至2029年3月。
content.en: Congratulations to Dr. Huaqing Liu and Dr. Jiahui Yang for each being awarded a Guangxi Natural Science Foundation Youth Project! Dr. Liu's project focuses on Tree Species Diversity Regulates Multi-source DOM Input Driving Soil Carbon Formation and Stabilization, while Dr. Yang's project addresses Quantitative Assessment and Future Trend Prediction of Soil Erosion on Sloping Farmland in Guangxi. Both projects run from April 2026 to March 2029.

title.zh: 祝贺刘华清获批国家自然科学基金青年基金项目（C类）
title.en: Congratulations to Dr. Huaqing Liu on receiving an NSFC Youth Fund award (Category C)

content.zh: 祝贺刘华清老师获批国家自然科学基金青年基金项目（C类），获批经费30万元，项目执行期为2027年1月至2029年12月，由刘华清老师主持。项目题目为「树种多样性对土壤有机碳垂向迁移与滞留的物理-生化耦合调节机制」。
content.en: Congratulations to Dr. Huaqing Liu on receiving a National Natural Science Foundation of China (NSFC) Youth Fund award (Category C), with funding of RMB 300,000. The project runs from January 2027 to December 2029 and is led by Dr. Huaqing Liu. The project is titled “Physical–biochemical coupled regulation mechanisms of soil organic carbon vertical transport and retention driven by tree species diversity.”

title.zh: 刘华清参加中国东部森林样带调查
title.en: Dr. Huaqing Liu Participates in the Eastern China Forest Transect Survey

content.zh:
2026年7月25日至9月4日，团队赴内蒙古、黑龙江、吉林、河北和山西等地，开展中国东部森林样带的野外调查和样品采集工作。刘华清老师参加了此次调查。

本次工作围绕森林样带调查开展，团队在不同区域进行野外调查与样品采集，为后续土壤生态学研究和相关数据分析积累基础资料。

content.en:
From July 25 to September 4, 2026, the team traveled to Inner Mongolia, Heilongjiang, Jilin, Hebei, Shanxi, and other regions to conduct field surveys and sample collection along the eastern China forest transect. Dr. Huaqing Liu participated in this field campaign.

The work focused on forest transect surveys, with field investigations and sample collection conducted across multiple regions. It provides foundational materials for subsequent soil ecological research and data analysis.

title.zh: 课题组在《Global and Planetary Change》发表青藏高原山坡解冻危害研究
title.en: New study reveals the spatial variability and future susceptibility of thaw hazards on Qinghai-Tibet Plateau hillslopes

content.zh:
杨佳慧等人在《Global and Planetary Change》发表题为“Spatial variability and future susceptibility of thaw hazards on hillslopes across the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau”的研究论文，文章编号为105647，发表于2026年8月13日的Version of Record版本。论文DOI为：https://doi.org/10.1016/j.gloplacha.2026.105647。

青藏高原多年冻土区广泛分布着山坡解冻危害，对区域景观稳定性和基础设施安全构成潜在威胁。为系统评估这类危害的空间分布及未来变化，研究团队基于文献资料建立了山坡解冻危害数据集，并通过目视解译识别非解冻危害样本。在此基础上，研究选取18个环境预测因子，利用9种机器学习和深度学习模型，对青藏高原多年冻土区山坡解冻危害的空间易感性进行了评估。

研究结果表明，NDVI、降水季节性、年均降水量和年均地温是影响山坡解冻危害易感性的关键环境预测因子。随机森林、Bagging、XGBoost和Gradient Boosting模型均取得了较高的预测性能，AUC均超过0.95。研究团队进一步采用SHAP方法解释模型预测结果，识别不同环境因子对山坡解冻危害易感性的相对贡献，并以这4种高性能模型预测结果的统计集成均值作为最终易感性预测结果，以降低单一模型带来的预测偏差。

空间分布结果显示，高易感性和极高易感性区域约占多年冻土区面积的5.53%，主要分布于青藏高原中部和东北部；低易感性和极低易感性区域占多年冻土区面积的89.39%，主要分布于青藏高原南部。未来情景预测表明，低易感性和极低易感性区域将略有扩大，而高易感性和极高易感性区域有所减少。

本研究建立了较为完善的山坡解冻危害综合评价体系，研究结果可为青藏高原山坡解冻危害清单编制、寒区地质灾害制图以及北半球寒区风险评估提供科学依据。
content.en:
Jiahui Yang and colleagues published a research article entitled “Spatial variability and future susceptibility of thaw hazards on hillslopes across the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau” in *Global and Planetary Change*. The article, numbered 105647, was published as the Version of Record on August 13, 2026. DOI: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.gloplacha.2026.105647.

Hillslope thaw hazards are widely distributed in the permafrost region of the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau and may threaten regional landscape stability and infrastructure safety. To systematically assess their spatial distribution and future changes, the research team developed a hillslope thaw-hazard dataset from published literature and identified non-thaw-hazard samples through visual interpretation. Eighteen environmental predictors were then selected, and nine machine-learning and deep-learning models were used to assess thaw-hazard susceptibility across the permafrost region of the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau.

The results showed that NDVI, precipitation seasonality, mean annual precipitation, and mean annual ground temperature were key environmental predictors of hillslope thaw-hazard susceptibility. Random Forest, Bagging, XGBoost, and Gradient Boosting achieved high predictive performance, with AUC values exceeding 0.95. The team further applied SHAP analysis to interpret the model predictions and identify the relative contributions of different environmental factors. The statistical ensemble mean of the predictions from these four high-performing models was used as the final susceptibility estimate to reduce potential bias from any single model.

The spatial assessment indicated that areas with high and extremely high susceptibility accounted for approximately 5.53% of the permafrost region and were mainly distributed in the central and northeastern Qinghai-Tibet Plateau. Areas with low and extremely low susceptibility accounted for 89.39% of the permafrost region and were mainly distributed in the southern part of the plateau. Future projections suggested a slight expansion of low- and extremely low-susceptibility areas, accompanied by a reduction in high- and extremely high-susceptibility areas.

This study establishes an improved comprehensive framework for assessing hillslope thaw hazards. The findings provide a scientific basis for compiling thaw-hazard inventories on the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau, mapping geological hazards in cold regions, and assessing risks across the cold regions of the Northern Hemisphere.

title.zh: 刘华清带队赴广西凭祥开展多树种混交林土壤调查
title.en: Research Team Conducts Field Survey at Pingxiang Multi-Species Mixed Forest

content.zh:
2026年4月4日至7日,广西大学刘华清老师带领研究团队前往广西壮族自治区凭祥市,对多树种混交实验样地进行了为期4天的土壤调查与样品采集工作。

## 样地概况

凭祥多树种混交实验样地由中国林业科学研究院热带林业研究中心建立,广西大学研究团队在此基础上进行了样方划定和样地调查工作。该样地位于广西壮族自治区凭祥市境内,旨在研究不同树种混交模式对土壤理化性质、微生物群落及生态系统功能的影响,本团队同时关注混交林对水分和碳素运移的影响。样地内种植有多种乡土树种和经济树种,为开展森林土壤生态学研究提供了理想的试验平台。

![样地标志牌](/images/news/2026-04-08-01.jpg)

## 调查内容

本次野外调查工作主要包括土壤样品采集和样地维护两个方面。

### 土壤样品采集

团队成员按照标准化采样方案,在样地内不同树种混交区域进行了系统的土壤剖面挖掘和样品采集。采集的土壤样品将用于分析土壤物理结构、化学性质以及微生物群落组成,为后续研究提供基础数据支撑。

![样地照片](/images/news/2026-04-08-02.jpg)

### 样地维护

调查期间,团队还对样地的标识牌、围栏等设施进行了检查和维护,确保样地长期监测工作的顺利开展。全体成员分工协作,高效完成了各项野外调查任务。

![土壤剖面](/images/news/2026-04-08-03.jpg)

## 后续工作

目前,采集的土壤样品已安全运回实验室。团队将开展系统的实验室分析工作,包括土壤物理性质测定、化学指标分析、微生物群落测序等。相关研究成果将为揭示多树种混交林土壤生态过程提供科学依据,并为区域森林经营管理提供理论支撑。

此次野外调查工作得到了中国林业科学研究院热带林业研究中心的大力支持和协助。
content.en:
From April 4 to 7, 2026, Dr. Huaqing Liu of Guangxi University led a research team to Pingxiang City, Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region, for a four-day field soil survey and sample collection at the multi-species mixed forest experimental plot.

## Site Overview

The Pingxiang multi-species mixed forest experimental plot was established by the Research Center of Tropical Forestry of the Chinese Academy of Forestry. The research team from Guangxi University conducted quadrat delineation and plot surveys on this basis. Located in Pingxiang City, Guangxi, the site aims to investigate the effects of different tree species mixing patterns on soil physicochemical properties, microbial communities, and ecosystem functions. Our team also focuses on the impacts of mixed forests on water and carbon transport. The plot contains a variety of native and economically important tree species, providing an ideal experimental platform for forest soil ecology research.

![Plot Signboard](/images/news/2026-04-08-01.jpg)

## Survey Content

The field survey primarily consisted of soil sample collection and plot maintenance.

### Soil Sample Collection

Following standardized sampling protocols, team members systematically excavated soil profiles and collected samples across different tree species mixing zones within the plot. These soil samples will be used to analyze soil physical structure, chemical properties, and microbial community composition, providing foundational data for subsequent research.

![Field Photos](/images/news/2026-04-08-02.jpg)

### Plot Maintenance

During the survey, the team also inspected and maintained the plot's signage, fences, and other facilities to ensure the smooth progress of long-term monitoring efforts. All members worked collaboratively and efficiently to complete the fieldwork tasks.

![Soil Profile](/images/news/2026-04-08-03.jpg)

## Follow-up Work

The collected soil samples have been safely transported back to the laboratory. The team will conduct systematic laboratory analyses, including soil physical property measurements, chemical indicator analyses, and microbial community sequencing. These research findings will provide scientific basis for understanding soil ecological processes in multi-species mixed forests and offer theoretical support for regional forest management practices.

We sincerely appreciate the strong support and assistance from the Research Center of Tropical Forestry, Chinese Academy of Forestry.
